item.title: Printable Safari Alphabet Banner A-Z & Numbers 0-9, Spell Any Name, Jungle Party PDF
item.description: Printable safari alphabet banner with all 26 letters and the numbers 0 to 9, each on its own flag with leaves, paw prints and animal print lettering. Print only the pages you need to spell a name, an age or a short message, then cut and hang. Flags are about 5.5 x 7.5 inches and print on A4 paper. Save this for your jungle party planning and tap to download on Etsy.
